pinned_method: Each input and each version in a separate process, GOMAXPROCS=1, taskset -c 10 (physical core 5), ABBA, 500ms x 2 per process, four samples per version/input. Shared host, not an exclusive core reservation. Main evidence for single-core CPU change.

accepted: Reuse unconsumed output tail as Huffman literal storage; combine literal-preservation and output bounds check
Track unbuffered Huffman bit positions only on refill, removing per-symbol position updates
rejected: Length-code lookup and additional FSE buffering: little gain and regressions on text/mixed inputs
Explicit small-copy fast paths: slower text; removed
Variable Huffman batch size and length-code fast paths: no consistent overall gain
Simpler copy source slice: not retained after mixed results; original copyMatch kept
findings.limits: No HTTP, live service, constrained-memory or sustained production load measurements. Unpinned 4-core concurrent entropy CPU was 5.4% higher in the final trials, while earlier trials showed a reduction; no universal multicore efficiency claim.
